body.text: If you can read this in Teams, the flow and the channel are working. No Stripe involved, nobody signed up, nothing to action.

facts.title: What this proves
facts.value: The flow triggers, and it can post an Adaptive Card into this channel.

facts.title: What it does not prove
facts.value: That Stripe can reach the flow, or that events get verified. Those come next.

facts.title: Next
facts.value: Swap this card for teams-card-signup.paste.json and add the Condition, HTTP verify, and Compose actions.
